intro.en: Tremors come without notice, so the preparation is in how we build and in what everyone knows: drop, cover and hold; and on the coast, the way to high ground.
intro.sw: Mitetemeko huja bila taarifa, hivyo maandalizi yako katika jinsi tunavyojenga na kile kila mtu anachokijua: inama, jifunike na shikilia; na pwani, njia ya kwenda mwinuko.

en: Know the earthquake history of this area: that it lies in the Rift zone, the tremors it has felt, their years and strength, and what they damaged; the committee keeps the record with the Geological Survey.
Know the open grounds near home, the school, the market and the places of worship, away from buildings, walls and wires, agreed as the places to gather after a tremor; keep them clear of structures.
sw: Fahamuni historia ya matetemeko ya eneo hili: kwamba liko kwenye ukanda wa Bonde la Ufa, mitetemeko iliyowahi kuhisiwa, miaka na ukubwa wake, na ilichoharibu; kamati inatunza kumbukumbu pamoja na Taasisi ya Jiolojia.

Fahamuni maeneo ya wazi karibu na nyumbani, shuleni, sokoni na nyumba za ibada, mbali na majengo, kuta na nyaya, yaliyokubaliwa kama mahali pa kukusanyika baada ya tetemeko; yawekwe wazi bila majengo.

en: Build with tied corners, ring beams and light roofs, and fix heavy shelves and water tanks so that they cannot fall.
Teach everyone at home: drop, cover and hold, then walk to the agreed open ground; practise it with the children.
sw: Jengeni kwa pembe zilizofungwa, boriti za kuzunguka na paa nyepesi, na fungeni rafu nzito na matangi ya maji yasianguke.
Fundisheni kila mtu nyumbani: inama, jifunike na shikilia, kisha tembeeni hadi eneo la wazi lililokubaliwa; fanyeni mazoezi pamoja na watoto.

en: Practise the earthquake drill twice a year and keep the exits clear.
sw: Fanyeni zoezi la tetemeko mara mbili kwa mwaka na wekeni njia za kutokea wazi.

en: Know the way to high ground from the home, the school and the landing site, and walk it once a year; everyone here should know that a long tremor or the sea pulling back is the sign to go up and stay up until the leaders say the sea has settled.
sw: Fahamuni njia ya kwenda mwinuko kutoka nyumbani, shuleni na mwaloni, na itembeeni mara moja kwa mwaka; kila mtu hapa ajue kuwa tetemeko refu au bahari kujiondoa ni ishara ya kupanda na kubaki juu hadi viongozi waseme bahari imetulia.

en: Apply the building code for masonry and public buildings, check schools and clinics, and keep GST's advice and the drill in the school calendar.
sw: Tumieni kanuni za ujenzi kwa majengo ya matofali na ya umma, kagueni shule na zahanati, na wekeni ushauri wa GST na zoezi kwenye kalenda ya shule.

en: Strengthen existing walls with bands and buttresses where an engineer advises, and keep a first-aid kit and a torch where they can be found in the dark.
sw: Imarisheni kuta zilizopo kwa mikanda na nguzo za kuegemeza pale mhandisi anaposhauri, na wekeni kifaa cha huduma ya kwanza na tochi mahali pa kupatikana gizani.

en: Assess and strengthen the schools, clinics and markets in the most exposed wards first, and train the response team in search and rescue with the Fire and Rescue Force.
sw: Fanyeni tathmini na imarisheni shule, zahanati na masoko ya kata zilizo hatarini zaidi kwanza, na fundisheni timu ya kukabiliana utafutaji na uokoaji pamoja na Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji.
